title: Recover the owner on the server machine
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Offer local maintenance for an authorized operator who lost both credentials. Confirm the store and owner, take exclusive access and issue fresh credentials.

**Verify** · Stop the real server, exercise wrong store, busy store and interrupted write, then restart and sign in as the same owner. Verify old sessions and recovery codes are invalid.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-056, WI-068

**Queue** · Follows WI-068 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
